name: Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent. Hold a weight plate, a dumbbell or a medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back until your torso and thighs make a V shape. Lift your feet off the floor for more difficulty.
Turn your torso to the right and bring the weight beside your hip.
Turn your torso to the left and bring the weight beside your other hip. Count each turn as one repetition.
